title: 第2章 答应娶女知青！
slug: 临时加彩礼转头另娶绝美女知青
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

王翠花听到陈卫东说他们家卖闺女，当即不悦道：“你们陈家没钱就别娶媳妇儿，凭着我家晓岚这长相，嫁到城里也不难，城里还要三转一响呢，不比三百块多？”

陈卫东看着王翠花冷笑道：“那你就等着让你闺女嫁到城里去吧。

这婚我不结了。

麻烦你们田家将我们陈家送的彩礼和东西都一并退了！”

陈大江也生气地跟着陈卫东后面附和：“对，王翠花，你们田家不守信用，临时加彩礼，先前我们陈家送的彩礼和东西都得一并退回！”

此时，田家这边也来了不少亲戚。

见事情闹腾得这么大，田家这边的亲戚朋友倒是劝着王翠花少加点彩礼，这大喜的日子闹到退婚的地步不好看。

而田家两口子要的就是让陈家知难而退。

他们家闺女处的那个男知青，听说可是首都的，是大城市的人。

若是陈家愿意加这二百块彩礼，他们将闺女嫁了也无妨。

可二百块的彩礼都不愿意加，按照原来定的那么点彩礼将闺女嫁到陈家去，岂不是亏大了？

田家当场退了一百块彩礼，还有陈家之前给田晓岚买的两身新衣服，以及送来的一百斤粮食。

田家这边退完了东西后，还让陈卫东写了字条，确认收到了他们家退换的所有物品。

两家人也立了字据，解除婚约，以后各不纠缠。

这一切忙完，陈家接亲的队伍这才从田家离开。

等走了一段距离，接亲的队伍中才有人憋不住骂了起来，“这田家人也太不是东西了！

既然觉得彩礼不够，咋不早说？

偏偏挑在结婚接亲的日子临时加，故意恶心人呢？

现在咋办？

这新娘子没接到，回去了不得闹笑话？让卫东怎么下得了台？”

说话的不是别人，正是陈卫东的三叔陈大海。

现在陈家那边酒席都摆了，亲戚朋友今天都到场了，若是新娘子接不回来，真得闹出来一个大笑话，以后陈家人在大队都抬不起头来。

相对于其他人的愁闷，陈卫东的神色则是轻松多了。

比起被人笑话一阵子，总比毁了自己和家人一辈子的幸福强。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

When Wang Cuihua heard that Chen Weidong said that their family was selling their daughters, she immediately said displeased: "If your Chen family doesn't have money, don't marry a daughter-in-law. With my Xiaolan's looks, it's not difficult to marry her in the city. The city still has to go around three times. Isn't it more than three hundred yuan?"

Chen Weidong looked at Wang Cuihua and sneered: "Then just wait until your daughter is married to the city.

I'm not getting married anymore.

Please, the Tian family, please return all the betrothal gifts and things sent by our Chen family!"

Chen Dajiang also followed Chen Weidong angrily and echoed: "Yes, Wang Cuihua, your Tian family broke your promise and temporarily increased the betrothal gift. All the betrothal gifts and things sent by our Chen family must be returned together!"

At this time, many relatives came to the Tian family.

Seeing that the matter was such a big fuss, the relatives and friends of the Tian family persuaded Wang Cuihua to add less betrothal gifts. It would not look good to break off the engagement on this special day.

What the Tian family couple wants is for the Chen family to retreat.

The male educated youth who was their daughter's virginity was said to be from the capital, a big city.

If the Chen family is willing to add the two hundred yuan as a bride price, there is no problem in marrying off their daughter.

But he is not willing to pay more than 200 yuan as a betrothal gift. If he marries his daughter to the Chen family with the originally planned betrothal gift, wouldn't it be a huge loss?

The Tian family refunded a hundred yuan as a gift on the spot, as well as the two new clothes the Chen family had bought for Tian Xiaolan, and the one hundred kilograms of grain they had sent.

After the Tian family returned the items, they asked Chen Weidong to write a note to confirm receipt of all the items returned by their family.

The two families also signed a written agreement to dissolve the engagement and not to be entangled in the future.

After all this was done, the Chen family's pick-up team left the Tian family.

After walking some distance, someone in the team that picked up the bride couldn't help but started to curse, "This Tian family is so useless!

Since you think the bride price is not enough, why didn’t you tell me earlier?

Why did you choose to add it on the day of the wedding to be deliberately disgusting?

What to do now?

The bride didn't receive it, how can she make a joke when she goes back?How could Weidong get off the stage?"

The speaker was none other than Chen Weidong's third uncle, Chen Dahai.

Now the banquet has been set up at the Chen family, and all relatives and friends are here today. If the bride cannot be picked up, it will really be a big joke. From now on, the Chen family will not be able to hold their heads high in the brigade.

Compared with the depression of others, Chen Weidong's expression was much more relaxed.

It is better than being laughed at for a while than ruining the happiness of yourself and your family for a lifetime.
